results.content: # Mathematical formulations and a Relax-and-Fix heuristic algorithm for capacitated reliable fixed-charge facility location problems. Capacity  Reliable facility location  Supply Chain Disruption  Optimisation  Relax-and-Fix heuristic. This paper addresses a novel capacitated version of the reliable fixed-charge facility location problem, where the failure probability of each facility is site-dependent, differing from existing literature models. Given the NP-hard nature of the problem, we propose a novel Relax-and-Fix heuristic for its solution. Results demonstrate that the Relax-and-Fix heuristic improves upper bounds for problem instances and achieves this within a shorter computational time. :   Mathematical formulations and a Relax-and-Fix heuristic algorithm for capacitated reliable fixed-charge facility location problems. :   Responsive Additive Manufacture to Overcome Natural and Attack-based disruption (RAMONA) project, EP/V051040/1, Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (United Kingdom, Swindon) - EPSRC. :   This work was supported by the UK Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC) as part of the Responsive Additive Manufacture to Overcome Natural and Attack-based disruption (RAMONA) project grant [EP/V051040/1]. Go to  My NCBI account settings  to confirm your email and then refresh this page. # Mathematical formulations and a Relax-and-Fix heuristic algorithm for capacitated reliable fixed-charge facility location problems. # Mathematical formulations and a Relax-and-Fix heuristic algorithm for capacitated reliable fixed-charge facility location problems. The reliable fixed-charge facility location problem extends the fixed-cost facility location problem by incorporating facility unreliability. This paper addresses a novel capacitated version of the reliable fixed-charge facility location problem, where the failure probability of each facility is site-dependent, differing from existing literature models. Results demonstrate that the Relax-and-Fix heuristic improves upper bounds for problem instances and achieves this within a shorter computational time. **Keywords:**  Capacity; Optimisation; Relax-and-Fix heuristic; Reliable facility location; Supply Chain Disruption.
